questions.question: An article sold for Rs. 765 after a discount of 15%. What was the marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 765

Discount = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = SP ÷ (1 - Discount/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ MP = 765 ÷ (1 - 15/100)

⇒ MP = 765 ÷ (1 - 0.15)

⇒ MP = 765 ÷ 0.85

⇒ MP = Rs. 900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 900.**

questions.question: In a warehouse, 7 crates of goods have an average weight of 84.5 kg. One of the crates, weighing 79.2 kg, is replaced by a new crate. As a result, the average weight becomes 87.1 kg. Later, 3 more crates are added, each weighing 91.3 kg. What is the weight of the new crate that replaced the old one?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of crates = 7

Initial average = 84.5

Old crate weight = 79.2

New average = 87.1

**Formula Used:**

Total sum = Average × Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial total = 7 × 84.5 = 591.5

⇒ New total after replacement = 7 × 87.1 = 609.7

⇒ Increase in total = 609.7 − 591.5 = 18.2

⇒ New crate weight = 79.2 + 18.2 = 97.4

**∴ The correct answer is 97.4.**

questions.question: A right circular cone has a height of 12 cm and a radius of 5 cm. Find its slant height and curved surface area.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height (h) = 12 cm

Radius (r) = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Slant height (l) = √(h² + r²)

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = π × r × l

**Calculation:**

⇒ l = √(12² + 5²)

⇒ l = √(144 + 25)

⇒ l = √169

⇒ l = 13 cm

⇒ CSA = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = 3.14 × 5 × 13

⇒ CSA = 204.2 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 13 cm and 204.2 cm².**

questions.question: Two circles with centers c₁ and c₂ have radii r₁ = 8 cm and r₂ = 7 cm, respectively. The distance between their centers is 17 cm. A common internal tangent touches the circles at points P₁ and P₂. What is the length of the segment P₁ P₂?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

r₁ = 8

r₂ = 7

Distance between centers = 17

**Formula Used:**

Length of internal tangent = √(d² − (r₁ + r₂)²)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Length = √(17² − (8 + 7)²)

⇒ Length = √(289 − 15²)

⇒ Length = √(289 − 225)

⇒ Length = √64 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

questions.question: Rice worth Rs. 120 per kg and Rs. 130 per kg are mixed with a third variety in the ratio 1 : 1 : 2. If the mixture is worth Rs. 150 per kg, what is the price of third variety per kg?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Price₁ = 120

Price₂ = 130

Ratio = 1 : 1 : 2

Mean price = 150

**Formula Used:**

Mean price = (Sum of (Price × Quantity)) ÷ Total quantity

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let price of third variety = x

⇒ Total quantity = 1 + 1 + 2 = 4

⇒ (120 × 1 + 130 × 1 + x × 2) ÷ 4 = 150

⇒ (120 + 130 + 2x) ÷ 4 = 150

⇒ 250 + 2x = 600

⇒ 2x = 350

⇒ x = 175

**∴ The correct answer is 175.**

questions.question: Aditya is twice as good a workman as Bipin and therefore can finish a job in 30 days less than Bipin. How many days are required to complete the job if working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Efficiency** (Aditya : Bipin) = 2 : 1

Ratio of **Time** taken (Aditya : Bipin) = 1 : 2

Difference in time = 2 − 1 = 1 unit → 30 days

**Aditya** takes 30 days and **Bipin** takes 60 days.

Time together = (30 × 60) ÷ (30 + 60) = 1800 ÷ 90 = 20 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Aditya** is twice as efficient as **Bipin**. **Aditya** takes 30 days less than **Bipin**.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = Efficiency × Time taken; Time taken = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

⇒ Let the time taken by **Bipin** be 2x days. Then time taken by **Aditya** is x days.

⇒ According to the question: 2x − x = 30 days

⇒ x = 30 days.

⇒ **Aditya**'s time = 30 days and **Bipin**'s time = 60 days.

⇒ Total Efficiency of **Aditya** and **Bipin** = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Total Work to be completed = 60 units.

⇒ Time required together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 3 = 20 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken to complete a task. If the ratio of efficiency is a:b, the ratio of time taken is b:a.

Combined Work Formula

If person A finishes work in X days and B in Y days, they finish together in (X × Y) ÷ (X + Y) days.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the **ratio of work done**, which is usually the same as the **ratio of efficiencies** if they work for the same duration.</p

questions.question: If tan θ + cot θ = 5, and θ is an acute angle, find the value of tan² θ + cot² θ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tanθ + cotθ = 5

θ is an acute angle

**Formula Used:**

tan²θ + cot²θ = (tanθ + cotθ)² - 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ tan²θ + cot²θ = (5)² - 2

⇒ tan²θ + cot²θ = 25 - 2

⇒ tan²θ + cot²θ = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

questions.question: A person covers some distance by car, travelling at 45 km/h in 4.6 hours, and the remaining distance by bus, travelling at 37.5 km/h in 4.2 hours. Find the total distance travelled by the person.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Total Distance** = (**Speed₁** × **Time₁**) + (**Speed₂** × **Time₂**)

**Total Distance** = (45 × 4.6) + (37.5 × 4.2)

**Total Distance** = 207 + 157.5 = 364.5 km

**∴ The correct answer is 364.5 km.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Speed of Car** = 45 km/h, **Time taken** = 4.6 hr

**Speed of Bus** = 37.5 km/h, **Time taken** = 4.2 hr

**Formula Used:**

**Distance** = **Speed** × **Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c3201a1cac55449f6538f2b8dfd14ec9d1c2ce827d6221a96ae4a0c22c4cc68.png] 

⇒ **Distance covered by car** = 45 × 4.6

⇒ **Distance covered by car** = 207 km

⇒ **Distance covered by bus** = 37.5 × 4.2

⇒ **Distance covered by bus** = 157.5 km

⇒ **Total Distance travelled** = 207 + 157.5

⇒ **Total Distance travelled** = 364.5 km

**∴ The correct answer is 364.5 km.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

**Average Speed** = **Total Distance** ÷ **Total Time**. In this case, **Average Speed** = 364.5 ÷ (4.6 + 4.2) km/h.

Speed Conversion Rule

To convert **Speed** from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the same direction, **Relative Speed** = **S₁ − S₂**. In opposite directions, **Relative Speed** = **S₁ + S₂**.</p

questions.question: A trader marks up an article by 25% on its cost price. He then offers two successive discounts: 10% followed by 5% on the marked price.If the cost price (CP) is ₹480, what is the final profit or loss percent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = 480

Markup = 25%

First discount = 10%

Second discount = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Marked price = CP × (1 + markup)

Selling price = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

Profit/Loss % = ((SP − CP) ÷ CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ MP = 480 × 1.25 = 600

⇒ After 10% discount: 600 × 0.9 = 540

⇒ After 5% discount: 540 × 0.95 = 513

⇒ SP = 513

⇒ Profit = 513 − 480 = 33

⇒ Profit % = (33 ÷ 480) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 6.875%

**∴ The correct answer is 6.875% profit.**

questions.question: Aman and Binoy enter into a partnership with capitals in the ratio 4:5. If the total profit is Rs 9,000, what will Aman's share be?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total profit = Rs 9,000

Capital ratio of Aman : Binoy = 4 : 5

**Formula Used:**

Aman’s share = (Aman's capital ratio ÷ Total ratio) × Total profit

Total ratio = Sum of individual ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total ratio = 4 + 5 = 9

⇒ Aman’s share = (4 ÷ 9) × 9,000

⇒ Aman’s share = 4 × 1,000 = Rs 4,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs 4,000.**

questions.question: The ratio of the length to the width of a rectangle is 7:4. If its perimeter is 88 cm, what is its area?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length to width ratio = 7:4

Perimeter = 88 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (Length + Width)

Area of rectangle = Length × Width

**Calculation:**

Let Length = 7x and Width = 4x (from the ratio).

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (7x + 4x)

⇒ 88 = 2 × (11x)

⇒ 88 ÷ 2 = 11x

⇒ x = 4

⇒ Length = 7 × 4 = 28 cm

⇒ Width = 4 × 4 = 16 cm

⇒ Area = Length × Width

⇒ Area = 28 × 16 = 448 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 448 cm².**

questions.question: Ravi's calorie intake for 6 days was 2100, 2200, 2000, 2300, 2400, and 2100. On the 7th day, he forgot to record his food. If the weekly average intake is 2200, how many calories did he consume on the 7th day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Calories for 6 days = 2100, 2200, 2000, 2300, 2400, 2100

Weekly average = 2200

**Formula Used:**

Total sum = Average × Number of days

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total for 7 days = 2200 × 7 = 15400

⇒ Sum of 6 days = 2100 + 2200 + 2000 + 2300 + 2400 + 2100

⇒ Sum of 6 days = 13100

⇒ Calories on 7th day = 15400 − 13100

⇒ Calories on 7th day = 2300

**∴ The correct answer is 2300.**

r² = d² + (chord ÷ 2)²

questions.question: Two chords, AB and CD, cross at point P inside a circle. Segments AP, PB, and CP have lengths of 6 cm, 8 cm, and 4 cm, respectively. How long is the chord CD in total?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AP = 6 cm

PB = 8 cm

CP = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Intersecting chords theorem: AP × PB = CP × PD

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6 × 8 = 4 × PD

⇒ 48 = 4 × PD

⇒ PD = 48 ÷ 4

⇒ PD = 12 cm

⇒ CD = CP + PD

⇒ CD = 4 + 12

⇒ CD = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

questions.question: If a certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 5 years 6 months at simple interest, then what will be the annual rate of interest (approximate)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

If a sum of money becomes **n times** of itself in **T years**, the annual rate of interest **R** is given by:

R = [100 × (n − 1)] ÷ T

Given: n = 2 (doubles), T = 5.5 years (5 years 6 months)

R = [100 × (2 − 1)] ÷ 5.5 = 100 ÷ 5.5 = 200 ÷ 11 ≈ 18.18%

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18 percent.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = P

Amount (A) = 2P (since the sum doubles itself)

Time (T) = **5 years 6 months** = 5 + 6/12 years = 5.5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ef4de1f0bed3bd7938916e71b46049ffdbac96660c7aa6fa4fdc8fa614da483.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = A − P

⇒ SI = 2P − P = P

⇒ P = (P × R × 5.5) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 = (R × 5.5) ÷ 100

⇒ R = 100 ÷ 5.5

⇒ R = 1000 ÷ 55 = 200 ÷ 11

⇒ R ≈ 18.1818...

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18 percent.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relationship between Rate and Time

For a sum to double under simple interest, the product of Rate (R) and Time (T) must always equal 100 (R × T = 100).

Simple Interest Formula

The amount (A) after time (T) is given by A = P × (1 + RT/100), where P is the principal and R is the annual rate.

Rule of 72 (Compound Interest)

To find the approximate time to double money at compound interest, divide 72 by the annual interest rate (T ≈ 72 ÷ R).

SI vs CI for first year

When the interest is compounded annually, the Simple Interest and Compound Interest for the first year are always equal.</p

questions.question: The difference between simple interest on a certain sum at the annual rate of 10 percent for 8 years and 10 years is Rs. 80. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 10%

Time difference = 10 − 8 = 2 years

Difference in SI = 80

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference in SI = (P × 10 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 80 = (P × 20) ÷ 100

⇒ 80 = P ÷ 5

⇒ P = 80 × 5

⇒ P = 400

**∴ The correct answer is 400.**

questions.question: Pipe A and B together can fill a tank in 16 minutes. Pipe B and C together can fill the same tank in 20 minutes. Pipe C and A together can fill the same tank in 24 minutes. Firstly pipe C is opened. After 'L' minutes, pipes A and B both are also opened. Remaining tank got filled in 4 minutes. What is the value of L?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 16 minutes

B + C = 20 minutes

C + A = 24 minutes

Remaining work filled in 4 minutes by A + B + C

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

Total work = Sum of individual rates

**Calculation:**

⇒ A + B = 1 ÷ 16

⇒ B + C = 1 ÷ 20

⇒ C + A = 1 ÷ 24

⇒ Adding all: 2(A + B + C) = 1 ÷ 16 + 1 ÷ 20 + 1 ÷ 24

⇒ LCM = 240

⇒ 1 ÷ 16 = 15 ÷ 240, 1 ÷ 20 = 12 ÷ 240, 1 ÷ 24 = 10 ÷ 240

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 37 ÷ 240

⇒ A + B + C = 37 ÷ 480

⇒ Work done in last 4 min = 4 × (37 ÷ 480)

⇒ = 148 ÷ 480 = 37 ÷ 120

⇒ Remaining work after C alone = 1 − 37 ÷ 120

⇒ = 83 ÷ 120

⇒ C = (B + C) − B

⇒ First find B

⇒ (A + B + C) − (A + B) = C

⇒ C = 37 ÷ 480 − 1 ÷ 16

⇒ 1 ÷ 16 = 30 ÷ 480

⇒ C = 7 ÷ 480

⇒ Work by C in L min = L × 7 ÷ 480

⇒ L × 7 ÷ 480 = 83 ÷ 120

⇒ L × 7 = (83 ÷ 120) × 480

⇒ L × 7 = 83 × 4 = 332

⇒ L = 332 ÷ 7

⇒ L ≈ 47.43 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 332 ÷ 7 minutes.**
